title: I made fundamental analysis super easy so any technical trader can use it.
author: KimOnMacro
selftext:
I think most traders either care about fundamentals but find it tricky, or just dont care at all.  
  
Tbh I get why though.   
Trading can work without it, it's hard to make fundamental checks repeatable and it might not feel fun looking at what banks or macro stuff is about.   
  
**So I've made it as simple, clean and fun (hopefully lol) to see what's going on outside the chart and apply it to any technical strategy:**  
  
This site:  
  
1. Lets you click a big candle and see what happened.   
2. Shows you visually where events are so you can see how technicals fit  
3. Show you the breaking news headlines now   
4. Shows what big institutions are doing  
5. Check if the fundamentals line up with seasonality  
6. Checks the most important intermarkets for that specific asset, updating every minute  
**7. Gives an overall fundamental read so it can give context to any technical strategy**  
  
Sources: Twelve Data, CFTC, Financial juice, FRED, FXmacrodata  
  
I've posted mini features of this before, usually focusing on one thing at a time. Hundreds of people have jumped on during the beta and we've emailed back and forth about what they liked, hated, and what could be better, which has led to a lot of changes.   
  
And finally, I'm now going to close the free beta over the next few days.  
  
If you'd like to poke at it and tell me what is a feature you would love to see added in or some other piece of data that you normally use in your premarket prep workflow Id love to hear it!  
  
You can try it free here: [https://echelonedgeai.com/](https://echelonedgeai.com/)  
  
  
**Also, while the free beta is closing, you can still do all of it for free through other sites:** 

1. Past moves for context: GPT + Reuters/CNBC  
2. Breaking news moves: Checking X accounts (Walter bloomberg/financial juice/firstsquawk)   
3. Upcoming events: Forex factory/Yahoofinance/tradingview  
4. Institutional trend: CFTC   
5. Seasonality: Tradingview seasonality heatmaps/seasonal charts  
6. Intermarket assets: Tradingview tickers
